import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega
import JudgeProblem

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace submission.Austin5833
inductive T where
  | e : T
  | k : T → T
  | p : T → T → T
  deriving DecidableEq
open T
def sz : T → Nat
  | e => 0
  | k a => sz a + 1
  | p a b => sz a + sz b + 2
def left : T → T
  | p a _ => a
  | _ => e
def right : T → T
  | p _ b => b
  | _ => e

mutual
inductive Code : T → T → T → Prop
  | law (x y z h₀ h₁ : T)
      (s₀ : Step z x h₀) (s₁ : Step h₀ y h₁) :
      Code y (p x (p y h₁)) x
inductive Step : T → T → T → Prop
  | raw (a b : T) : Step a b (p a b)
  | hit {a b o : T} (h : Code a b o) : Step a b o
end

theorem code_bounds {a b o : T} (h : Code a b o) : sz a < sz b ∧ sz o < sz b := by
  apply Code.rec (motive_1 := fun a b o _ => sz a < sz b ∧ sz o < sz b)
    (motive_2 := fun a b o _ => sz a < sz (p o b)) ?_ ?_ ?_ h
  · intro x y z h₀ h₁ s₀ s₁ ih₀ ih₁
    simp only [sz] at ih₀ ih₁ ⊢
    constructor <;> omega
  · intro a b
    simp only [sz]
    omega
  · intro a b o hc ih
    simp only [sz]
    omega

theorem code_key {a b o : T} (h : Code a b o) : left (right b) = a := by
  cases h
  rfl

theorem code_shape {a b o : T} (h : Code a b o) :
    ∃ x y z h₀ h₁, Step z x h₀ ∧ Step h₀ y h₁ ∧
      a = y ∧ b = p x (p y h₁) ∧ o = x := by
  cases h
  exact ⟨_, _, _, _, _, by assumption, by assumption, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

theorem step_first_unique {a q b o : T} (h : Step a b o) (k : Step q b o) : a = q := by
  cases h with
  | raw =>
    cases k with
    | raw => rfl
    | hit hc =>
      have hb := (code_bounds hc).2
      simp only [sz] at hb
      omega
  | hit hc =>
    cases k with
    | raw =>
      have hb := (code_bounds hc).2
      simp only [sz] at hb
      omega
    | hit hk => exact (code_key hc).symm.trans (code_key hk)

theorem code_output {a b o : T} (h : Code a b o) : left b = o := by
  cases h
  rfl

theorem code_unique {a b o q : T} (h : Code a b o) (k : Code a b q) : o = q :=
  (code_output h).symm.trans (code_output k)

theorem step_ne_second {a b : T} (h : Step a b b) : False := by
  cases h with
  | hit hc =>
    have hb := (code_bounds hc).2
    omega

theorem no_code_after_step {a b o : T} (h : Step a b o) : ¬ ∃ q, Code b o q := by
  rintro ⟨q,hc⟩
  cases h with
  | raw =>
    obtain ⟨x,y,z,h₀,h₁,s₀,s₁,hb,hp,hq⟩ := code_shape hc
    have ht : b = p y h₁ := congrArg right hp
    rw [← hb] at ht
    have hs := congrArg sz ht
    simp only [sz] at hs
    omega
  | hit h₀ =>
    have hsmall := (code_bounds h₀).2
    have hlarge := (code_bounds hc).1
    omega

theorem step_bound {a b o : T} (h : Step a b o) : sz a < sz (p o b) := by
  cases h with
  | raw => simp only [sz]; omega
  | hit hc =>
    have hb := (code_bounds hc).1
    simp only [sz]
    omega

theorem no_code_paired {x y z h₀ h₁ : T}
    (s₀ : Step z x h₀) (s₁ : Step h₀ y h₁) : ¬ ∃ q, Code x (p y h₁) q := by
  rintro ⟨q,hc⟩
  cases s₁ with
  | raw =>
    have hk := code_key hc
    change h₀ = x at hk
    rw [hk] at s₀
    exact step_ne_second s₀
  | hit hx =>
    obtain ⟨xx,yy,zz,t₀,t₁,r₀,r₁,ha,hb,ho⟩ := code_shape hc
    have ht : h₁ = p yy t₁ := congrArg right hb
    have hy : y = xx := congrArg left hb
    have hr := step_bound r₁
    have hs : sz t₀ < sz h₁ := by
      rw [ht]
      simp only [sz] at hr ⊢
      omega
    rw [← hy] at r₀
    cases r₀ with
    | raw =>
      have hh := (code_bounds hx).2
      simp only [sz] at hs
      omega
    | hit hz =>
      have he : t₀ = h₁ := (code_output hz).symm.trans (code_output hx)
      rw [he] at hs
      omega

noncomputable def eval (a b : T) : T := by
  classical
  exact if h : ∃ o, Code a b o then Classical.choose h else p a b
theorem eval_hit {a b o : T} (h : Code a b o) : eval a b = o := by
  rw [eval, dif_pos ⟨o,h⟩]
  exact code_unique (Classical.choose_spec ⟨o,h⟩) h
theorem eval_raw {a b : T} (h : ¬ ∃ o, Code a b o) : eval a b = p a b := by
  rw [eval, dif_neg h]
theorem eval_step (a b : T) : Step a b (eval a b) := by
  by_cases h : ∃ o, Code a b o
  · obtain ⟨o,h⟩ := h
    rw [eval_hit h]
    exact Step.hit h
  · rw [eval_raw h]
    exact Step.raw a b

abbrev Carrier := T
noncomputable def mul : Carrier → Carrier → Carrier := eval
theorem equation5833 (x y z : Carrier) : mul y (mul x (mul y (mul (mul z x) y))) = x := by
  change eval y (eval x (eval y (eval (eval z x) y))) = x
  have s₀ := eval_step z x
  have s₁ := eval_step (eval z x) y
  have h₀ : eval y (eval (eval z x) y) = p y (eval (eval z x) y) := eval_raw (no_code_after_step s₁)
  rw [h₀]
  have h₁ : eval x (p y (eval (eval z x) y)) = p x (p y (eval (eval z x) y)) :=
    eval_raw (no_code_paired s₀ s₁)
  rw [h₁]
  exact eval_hit (Code.law x y z _ _ s₀ s₁)

def tower : Nat → T
  | 0 => e
  | n+1 => k (tower n)
theorem tower_size (n : Nat) : sz (tower n) = n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp only [tower, sz, ih]
def embed : Nat → Carrier := tower
theorem embed_injective (n j : Nat) (h : embed n = embed j) : n = j := by
  have hh := congrArg sz h
  change sz (tower n) = sz (tower j) at hh
  simpa only [tower_size] using hh
noncomputable def opposite (a b : Carrier) : Carrier := mul b a
theorem equation40070 (x y z : Carrier) :
    opposite (opposite (opposite (opposite y (opposite x z)) y) x) y = x :=
  equation5833 x y z
theorem infinite_model : ∃ (A : Type) (op : A → A → A) (f : Nat → A),
    (∀ x y z, op y (op x (op y (op (op z x) y))) = x) ∧
    (∀ n j, f n = f j → n = j) :=
  ⟨Carrier, mul, embed, equation5833, embed_injective⟩
end submission.Austin5833

namespace submission
abbrev CM := Austin5833.Carrier
namespace CM
theorem tower_injective (n j : Nat)
    (h : Austin5833.embed n = Austin5833.embed j) : n = j :=
  Austin5833.embed_injective n j h
end CM
noncomputable instance modelMagma : Magma CM := ⟨Austin5833.opposite⟩
end submission
theorem submission : Goal := by
  refine ⟨submission.CM, submission.modelMagma, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x y z
    exact (submission.Austin5833.equation40070 x y z).symm
  · intro h
    have bad : 0 = 1 := submission.Austin5833.embed_injective 0 1
      (h (submission.Austin5833.embed 0) (submission.Austin5833.embed 1))
    exact Nat.noConfusion bad
example : Goal := submission
#print axioms submission
#print axioms submission.CM.tower_injective
